{{Quote|The design product cannot be allowed to escape. If it is allowed uncontrolled breeding on an unprepared world everything else will be replaced in favor of this design.|A scientific journal entry|<ref name="SWG:RO">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Rescue Operation|Talus}}</ref>}}
The '''Parasophic Arachne''' program was an illegal [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineering]] project conducted by the [[GeneTech Syndicate]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
{{Quote|The lab knows nothing about the intelligence these creatures are exhibiting. They ambushed us on the way to their lair, and every time I use my datapad, the creatures seem to get agitated. Their life stages are progressing far faster than anticipated. The Empire would have paid quite well for these if we had actually made it to...|The last datapad entry from a GeneTech Syndicate member|<ref name="SWG:GD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Grim Discovery|Talus}}</ref>}}
[[File:GeneTech_Syndicate_Lab.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The [[GeneTech Syndicate Lab]].]]
The Parasophic Arachne program was a class 5 biological research and development project carried out by the GeneTech Syndicate company. The aim of the program was to create an intelligent form of [[arachne]]s for the use of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Those arachnes could be released onto a world the Empire did not want to spend troops on, but did not want it to be used by its enemies. Even though the creatures would thoroughly destroy the native ecology, the planet would be effectively rendered uninhabitable.<ref name="SWG:G">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Genocide|Talus}}</ref>

The project was secretly developed in a [[GeneTech Syndicate Lab|laboratory]] located just outside the city of [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]], on the planet [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], a lab listed as engaging in legitimate genetic manipulation on animals. Highly dangerous, the Parasophic Arachne program was even more illegal as it was conducted on an inhabited planet.<ref name="SWG:G" /> The project was led by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Vigh]], the [[Chief Scientist/Legends|chief scientist]] of the GeneTech Syndicate.<ref name="GP">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=66911&resource=features|text=Genetic Potential}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Your Master is dead. The experiment is a failure."<br />"That cannot be! Before these creatures came he was just fine."<br />"These creatures killed him. They are going to kill everyone on Talus if you do not help me!|A spacer and [[6-POC]]|<ref name="SWG:ABLTG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|A Better Life Through Genetics|Talus}}</ref>}}
[[File:Arachne_crash_site.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Arachnes around the crashed ship.]]
The scientific part of the Parasophic Arachne program could be initially considered as a success since the GeneTech Syndicate scientists eventually managed to create deadly and intelligent creatures.<ref name="SWG:GD" /> Some time after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Doctor Vigh ordered to transport several specimens to the [[Imperial research facility (Nubia)|Imperial research facility]] on [[Nubia/Legends|Nubia]]. However, the transport carrying the creatures crashed in the mountains near the city of [[Nashal]] just after its departure.<ref name="GP" /> Moreover, the arachnes in the lab escaped containment and overwhelmed their creators, slaughtering most of the staff of the lab,<ref name="SWG:G" /> including the project manager.<ref name="SWG:ABLTG" /> All the surviving scientists quickly fled and went into hiding to avoid being arrested by the [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] and charged with illegal biological experiments.<ref name="SWG:G" /> [[Jana T'bayr]] was the sole scientist to remain in the lab. She initially wanted to save the project but she then tried to find a way to prevent the parasophic arachnes from destroying the planet Talus.<ref name="SWG:AB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Adaptive Biology|Talus}}</ref>

The Parasophic Arachne program was exposed after the ship carrying engineered arachnes crashed in the mountains near Nashal,<ref name="SWG:RO" /> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> CorSec [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Taarna]] dispatched a spacer to investigate the crash site and rescue any survivors.<ref name="SWG:RO" /> However, the spacer discovered that [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Narl (captain)|Narl]] and all the other survivors were killed while trying to prevent the arachnes from escaping in the wilderness.<ref name="SWG:GD" />

[[File:AdaptiveBiology-GH.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Spacers discovering the queen's mate.]]
The CorSec later traced the flight trajectory of the crashed ship and found that it took off from Dearic. A CorSec scout team then discovered that the GeneTech Syndicate Lab near Dearic was undergoing an emergency evacuation.<ref name="SWG:G" /> Agent Taarna recruited spacers who headed to the lab and discovered that the building was completely overwhelmed by the bioengineered creatures. The spacers first located the directory terminal and downloaded evidences and details about the project known as Parasophic Arachne.<ref name="SWG:G" /> Taarna therefore ordered his CorSec crew to clear the lab.<ref name="SWG:AB" /> With the help of [[6-POC]], the project manager's [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], the spacers managed to delete all scientific data that could be used to restart the program.<ref name="SWG:ABLTG" /> They also retrieved a self-destruct intron virus, a virus designed specifically by the GeneTech Syndicate scientists to kill the arachnes. The spacers applied this virus to every arachne [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] they found in the lab.<ref name="SWG:FtS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Find the Source|Talus}}</ref> In the meantime, they fought and killed many arachnes in the lab.<ref name="SWG:PfP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Plea for Pity|Talus}}</ref> Agent Taarna later tasked the spacer to eliminate the arachne queen, the arachne responsible for breeding the parasophic arachnes. The spacers found the queen, a gigantic arachne, at the lowest level of the lab and finally killed her. Taarna thought that the new arachne species was doomed with the death of the queen.<ref name="SWG:G" /> However, Jana T'bayr revealed that another arachne, the queen's mate, was still posing a threat. The queen's mate was much larger and stronger than other arachnes and designed to be exceptionally durable. While much of the queen mass was dedicated to reproductive functions, her mate however was almost entirely devoted to combat. Furthermore, if the queen's mate was the only arachne left, he could morph into a breeder and could repopulate the species by himself. A group of spacers found the queen's mate in another part of the lab and, after an intense fight, managed to kill the dreadful creature.<ref name="SWG:AB" /> The destruction of all the breeding arachnes and eggs eliminated the Parasophic Arachne threat.<ref name="SWG:G" />

After the planet Talus was saved from the bioenineered arachnes, the CorSec targeted the escaped Genetech Syndicate scientists. The CorSec also filed a complaint with the [[Imperial Research Division]] against the GeneTech Syndicate for carrying out class 5 biological experiments on an inhabited world. Nevertheless, Agent Taarna was very pessimistic and thought that the investigation would be very complex and a very long time would be necessary before any trial. In any case, the spacers involved in the fight against the arachnes received a very generous reward from the [[Federation of the Double Worlds|Talusian government]].<ref name="SWG:G" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Parasophic Arachne program appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:G" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Parasophic Arachne program was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Rescue Operation|Genetic Potential]]" and "[[W:c:swg:Genocide|Deifying Decisions]]" arcs with the release of "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 2|Chapter 2: The Talus Incident]]," on [[August 1]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 2: The Talus Incident Publish Notes, August 1st">{{SonyForumsCite|full_url=http://soe.lithium.com/swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=58871|text="Chapter 2: The Talus Incident" Publish Notes, August 1st}}</ref>
